name: Yang Shen
bio: Yang Shen (楊慎, courtesy name Yongxiu, literary name Shengan) was a Ming dynasty scholar-official from Xindu county in Sichuan. He took first place in the metropolitan examination (jinshi) of 1511 and entered the Hanlin Academy.
In the Great Rites controversy of the 1520s he opposed the Jiajing Emperor and was beaten at court and exiled to Yunnan, where he lived for the rest of his life and wrote prolifically.
His lyric to the tune Lin jiang xian opens his verse history Ershiyi shi tanci (二十一史彈詞), and was later set at the head of the novel Romance of the Three Kingdoms, in which form it is best known.

poems.title: 臨江仙·滾滾長江東逝水 (Lin jiang xian · Gun gun Chang jiang dong shi shui)
poems.author: Yang Shen
poems.text:
滾滾長江東逝水，浪花淘盡英雄。
是非成敗轉頭空。
青山依舊在，幾度夕陽紅。

白髮漁樵江渚上，慣看秋月春風。
一壺濁酒喜相逢。
古今多少事，都付笑談中。
